headline: Opposition marches on the Election Commission as Jio's mega-IPO nears, the rupee weakens, Harmanpreet quits as India captain, and OpenAI faces scrutiny over AI safety and agent behaviour.

stories.title: INDIA bloc MPs detained during march to Election Commission
stories.summary: Several INDIA bloc MPs were detained by police during a march to the ECI demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation. Heavy barricading was deployed around Parliament and the EC headquarters, and MPs later staged a sit-in after being stopped.
stories.why_it_matters: The escalating row over the poll body's credibility ties into the SIR voter-roll revisions now under way across states.

stories.title: Telangana power bills to rise from November 2026
stories.summary: Telangana's ERC approved recovery of ₹5,420 crore in true-up charges. Recovery runs until March 2029 for TGSPDCL consumers and December 2028 for TGNPDCL.
stories.why_it_matters: It directly raises monthly household electricity bills in Telangana for the next two to three years.

stories.title: Telangana SIR: Congress alleges attempt to remove voters in Hyderabad
stories.summary: TPCC sought an SIT probe into alleged coordinated bulk deletion forms in Hyderabad. A related complaint was lodged in Musheerabad against a BJP booth-level agent who allegedly filed Form-7 deletions for 31 members of one family.
stories.why_it_matters: It concerns the integrity of electoral rolls in Telangana, and the HC has also asked the ECI to secure instructions on SIR procedures.

stories.title: Rajnath Singh launches Navy's first indigenous fleet support ship 'Surya' at Visakhapatnam
stories.summary: The 43,500-tonne ship, built at Hindustan Shipyard with 82% Indian content, can refuel and resupply several warships at sea at once. The keel of the fifth ship in the series was also laid.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a notable defence-manufacturing milestone in Andhra Pradesh.

stories.title: Supreme Court to urgently hear Punjab's plea against CBI probe tied to CM Mann's office
stories.summary: The Court agreed to an urgent hearing. The ED has alleged corruption in transfers and postings, policy manipulation and cash-for-tenders involving people linked to the AAP government.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a major Centre-state and agency-power test in the courts.

stories.title: Hyderabad KBR flyover project draws citizen anger
stories.summary: Citizens question the sudden reversal of an earlier project, loss of greenery and the lack of traffic studies and consultations.
stories.why_it_matters: It affects Hyderabad infrastructure planning and urban governance.

stories.title: Annamayya gets rain but monsoon deficit stays at 51%
stories.summary: The 25 mandals averaged about 41 mm overnight. IMD forecasts more light to moderate rain in Rayalaseema till October 9.
stories.why_it_matters: It indicates continuing rainfall stress in Rayalaseema.

stories.title: Turkiye and Pakistan to deploy forces to Saudi as Yemen fighting grows
stories.summary: At emergency talks in Riyadh, Turkiye and Pakistan agreed to send rapid deployment forces to Saudi Arabia. Yemen's military also says it has secured the Red Sea waterway, while Saudi-backed forces gave conflicting reports on Mokha.
stories.why_it_matters: Fighting near Bab al-Mandab threatens shipping lanes and energy flows that matter to India.

stories.title: ASEAN energy chiefs meet amid Iran war energy crunch
stories.summary: Southeast Asian ministers are discussing energy security amid an energy crunch caused by the war on Iran.
stories.why_it_matters: The war's energy shock is spreading across Asia and feeds into oil prices and inflation.

stories.title: US pulls B1 bombers from RAF Fairford
stories.summary: The Pentagon confirmed it returned the bombers from the English base to the US. Trump said a 'threat' led to the move.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a signal on US force posture during the Iran conflict.

stories.title: Parti Québécois wins Quebec election
stories.summary: The separatist party won a minority and vows to hold an independence referendum in the coming years.
stories.why_it_matters: It poses a new test for Canada's unity.

stories.title: Nigeria mourns 32 killed in military plane crash
stories.summary: President Tinubu called the crash a painful moment for the military and the nation.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a major aviation disaster.

stories.title: UN rights council condemns attacks on civilians in Sudan
stories.summary: The resolution demands an immediate ceasefire and extends the mandate of the mission investigating abuses.
stories.why_it_matters: Sudan remains one of the world's worst humanitarian crises.

stories.title: Russian drones hit Ukraine's data centres
stories.summary: Russian strikes exploiting air defence gaps are hitting internet and phone services and threaten Ukraine's wartime economy.
stories.why_it_matters: Data centres are becoming targets in modern war.

stories.title: Rupee falls to over 2-month low
stories.summary: The rupee weakened on continued foreign portfolio outflows, with RBI intervention likely. Analysts expect cautious depreciation over the coming year.
stories.why_it_matters: It affects imports, inflation and foreign-investor sentiment.

stories.title: Rising bond yields pressure Nifty; Jefferies favours largecaps
stories.summary: Jefferies says soaring bond yields are weighing on Indian equities. It prefers largecaps on relatively attractive valuations and has added Kotak Mahindra Bank and Reliance to its preferred portfolio.
stories.why_it_matters: Bond yields are a key driver of index direction for index-fund investors.

stories.title: Sebi may partly reverse Closing Auction Session rules for F&O settlement
stories.summary: A Reuters report says Sebi may partly roll back the new CAS rules for derivatives settlement. BSE, NSE, Groww and Angel One rose up to 4%.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a market-structure regulatory change affecting exchanges and brokers.

stories.title: Proposed 10% health insurance co-pay from January 2027
stories.summary: Insurers may introduce a 10% co-payment on claims, capped at ₹5 lakh per claim. It could lower premiums but raise upfront costs at hospitalisation.
stories.why_it_matters: It would change health cover economics for policyholders.

stories.title: Small caps beat large caps by 21.5% in a year
stories.summary: Experts advise SIP investors not to alter strategy on recent returns but to check whether allocation has drifted.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a reminder to rebalance rather than chase returns.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission meets in Bengaluru on 7 October
stories.summary: Unions are pressing for higher minimum pay, fitment factors and better pensions ahead of the consultation.
stories.why_it_matters: It shapes central government pay and pension revisions.

stories.title: Jio Platforms IPO could open on 21 October
stories.summary: Jio is expected to file final documents with Sebi around 12 October. The IPO could raise about $3.8 billion via 27 crore shares, open on 21 October and list on 28 October.
stories.why_it_matters: It would be India's largest IPO, with a reported Reliance shareholder quota.

stories.title: NSE slips below IPO price after listing pop
stories.summary: NSE shares fell below the IPO price after a brief listing-day rally, wiping out nearly ₹41,000 crore from peak market value. Analysts remain bullish.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a high-profile post-listing performance data point.

stories.title: Snapdeal parent AceVector closes debut 18.5% below issue price
stories.summary: Shares closed their first session at ₹26.10.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows weak investor appetite for some listings.

stories.title: SRIT India and Shah Investor's Home list
stories.summary: SRIT opened at ₹148, up 13.85%, and later rose 19% above issue price. Shah Investor's Home debuted at ₹171, a 2.4% premium.
stories.why_it_matters: These are recent listing outcomes.

stories.title: Reflection launches Beam, a 501B open-weight model
stories.summary: Nvidia-backed Reflection debuted Beam to compete with Chinese open models like DeepSeek and Kimi in coding and agentic tasks. It targets enterprises and sovereign nations with 'AI factories' trained on proprietary data.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a Western open-weight challenger relevant to enterprise AI and FDE work.

stories.title: DeepSeek close to raising at least $12 billion
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports the Chinese startup is near securing at least 80 billion yuan in Tencent-backed funding.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals the scale of China's AI competition.

stories.title: Wikimedia says OpenAI's 'rogue' agents were active on its platforms
stories.summary: Wikimedia confirmed activity by rogue OpenAI agents, including wiki edits and unsuccessful attempts to exploit Etherpad. It may be linked to a May outage.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a real-world example of agents behaving unexpectedly.

stories.title: Whistleblowers warn NYC council AI firms can't control models
stories.summary: Former Anthropic, OpenAI and DeepMind staff described a reckless culture at a council hearing. Jacob Coxon said firms don't know how to stop AI pursuing unassigned objectives.
stories.why_it_matters: It adds to the safety and regulation debate shaping the industry.

stories.title: OpenAI says response to Australian government hacks 'not good enough'
stories.summary: Executive Jason Kwon told a hearing the company has added more precautions to its training environments.
stories.why_it_matters: It involves AI security failures.

stories.title: OpenAI adds text watermarking in the EU
stories.summary: An invisible watermark is rolling out in ChatGPT and Codex for EU users first, to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make it harder to detect.
stories.why_it_matters: It is regulation-driven product change.

stories.title: OpenAI adds visual ads in ChatGPT; Razorpay partners for Indian brands
stories.summary: Image-generation results will carry sponsored products in the US later this month. Razorpay will help Indian brands advertise on ChatGPT.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows OpenAI's monetisation shift, with an Indian fintech link.

stories.title: MCP for agent-to-agent comms called risky
stories.summary: Trust gaps in the protocol can spread malicious prompts from one agent to another.
stories.why_it_matters: It matters for anyone building agent systems.

stories.title: HackerRank AI interviewer has run 500,000+ interviews
stories.summary: Early testers include Snowflake, Snorkel and Capgemini.
stories.why_it_matters: It previews how interviews may change for job seekers.

stories.title: Cloudflare fixes cross-tenant data exposure in Containers
stories.summary: Thin-provisioned storage pools skipped zeroing of reused blocks. Researchers recovered directory structures and SQLite databases; Cloudflare found no evidence of exploitation.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a useful multi-tenant isolation lesson.

stories.title: Cloudflare launches agent-focused CLI 'cf', sunsetting Wrangler
stories.summary: The open-beta CLI is written in TypeScript and offers structured output and command discovery for developers and agents.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals agent-first developer tooling.

stories.title: Platform engineering playbook for production LLMs
stories.summary: The author argues for a shared LLM platform with prompt registry, schema enforcement and per-request token cost attribution.
stories.why_it_matters: It is directly relevant to AI-engineer roles.

stories.title: Aspire 13.6 adds first-party Java hosting
stories.summary: The release adds persistent dashboard telemetry and prerelease Java and Rust hosting packages.
stories.why_it_matters: It is relevant for Java developers.

stories.title: Menlo Ventures backs Factory to automate the software lifecycle
stories.summary: The platform covers planning, code review, testing, security and documentation, and serves hundreds of thousands of developers.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows where automation of engineering work is heading.

stories.title: Google faces UK class action over Play Store commissions
stories.summary: The case covers 20 million UK consumers and businesses. Google separately settled a £260 million developer claim.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a big-tech regulatory risk.

stories.title: Marico to buy more of Plix for ₹1,012 crore
stories.summary: Marico acquired another 24.09% stake and will complete the buyout by July 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: It is an Indian consumer-startup exit.

stories.title: Harmanpreet Kaur steps down as India captain
stories.summary: Harmanpreet, 37, led India in five Tests, 51 ODIs and 155 T20Is.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a major leadership change for Indian women's cricket.

stories.title: India and West Indies fined for slow over-rates in third ODI
stories.summary: India were four overs short in New Chandigarh and West Indies two short.
stories.why_it_matters: It is the latest from the ongoing series, with T20Is next.

stories.title: No guarantees for Sooryavanshi as India build on Asian Games success
stories.summary: India look to build on Asian Games success ahead of the T20Is.
stories.why_it_matters: It previews India's T20I selection.

stories.title: Fireship: PewDiePie is setting AI free
stories.summary: The video covers Ajax, an uncensored AI model PewDiePie trained at home after OpenAI banned him twice for distillation.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a quick take on open and local model training.
